canonical_project: Pi Data Centers Mumbai (Phase I, 3 MW)
notes: Pi Data Centers announced (13 Apr 2026) a 3 MW Phase I data centre in central Mumbai scheduled to go live in August 2026, its first Mumbai facility, with JLL as leasing advisor; part of a broader 23 MW expansion plan. Data Center Map places the facility in central Mumbai (postal 400008, Wadala area, Mumbai City district).
